description: Apply sort conditions to a view. Default mode replaces all existing sorts — pass an empty array with operation="replace" to clear. Use operation="append" to add new sorts on top of the view's existing sort stack without rewriting them.

debug.description: When true, include raw Airtable response in output for diagnostics

operation.description: How the given sorts interact with existing sorts. "replace" (default) overwrites; "append" adds the provided sorts after the existing sort stack (secondary priority).

sorts.description: Array of sort conditions. Empty array [] clears all sorts when operation="replace".

ascending.description: true for A→Z / 1→9, false for Z→A / 9→1. Default: true

name: apply_view_sorts
